card.name: Ancient Telescope
card.officialEffect: See the top 5 cards of your opponent's Deck. Return the cards to the Deck in the same order.

design.topOfDeck: Index zero is the top of the Deck in duelEngineCurrent.createDuel and handFlow.drawCards; the adapter copies deck.slice(0,5) without mutation.
design.tagTarget: In classic 2v2, 'opponent's Deck' is resolved as the currently active opposing physical seat's private Deck; the inactive partner's reserve Deck is not inspected.
design.privacy: The reveal contract is controller-private and names the exact physical member allowed to see it. A Discord caller must send it ephemerally; this adapter does not publish or send messages.
design.order: The same top-card order is returned and the Deck remains unchanged.
design.integration: Pure adapter only; card metadata, resolver registration and Discord command integration are intentionally pending explicit M61 handoff.

tests: top five cards in Deck order
active opposing physical seat selected, inactive reserve excluded
partial Deck reveals all remaining cards
empty Deck returns an empty reveal
source physical UID must exist exactly once
duplicate event remains idempotent after rotation/Deck changes
input, Deck, hand, reserves and ledger immutability
reveal contains only copied physical identity fields

certification.reason: Adapter-only; no card metadata, effect definition, resolver, certification, manifest, allowlist or catalog changes.

limitations: The adapter does not add Ancient Telescope to the playable card catalog; it is not yet available in a real duel.
Tests use structural TagDuel fixtures because the central card admission/resolver files remain reserved by M61.
The private visibility field is a caller contract; live Discord ephemeral delivery has not been validated.
No certification or inventory grant is claimed.
